is_archived.description: Whether the item is archived or not

is_draft.description: Whether the item is a draft or not

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new item in a Webflow CMS collection. Provide the collection ID and the field values (keyed by field slug); optionally mark the item as archived or draft. Use to add CMS content like blog posts or products. Each call creates a distinct item, so it is not idempotent.

delete_collection_item.name: delete_collection_item
delete_collection_item.displayName: Delete an item in a collection

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a single item from a Webflow CMS collection, identified by collection ID and item ID. Use when an agent needs to remove existing CMS content. Repeating the call after the item is gone has no further effect, so it is effectively idempotent on the same item ID.

update_collection_item.name: update_collection_item
update_collection_item.displayName: Update an item in a collection

is_archived.description: Whether the item is archived or not

is_draft.description: Whether the item is a draft or not

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Webflow CMS collection item, identified by collection ID and item ID, overwriting the supplied field values (keyed by field slug) and the archived/draft flags. Use to edit existing CMS content. Idempotent: applying the same field values repeatedly yields the same item state.

find_collection_item.name: find_collection_item
find_collection_item.displayName: Find a Collection Item by Field
find_collection_item.description: Find collection item in a collection by field

field_name.description: The name of the field to search by

field_value.description: The value of the field to search for

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return

aiMetadata.description: Searches a Webflow CMS collection for items whose given field name exactly matches the supplied value, optionally capped by a max-results limit. Use to look up an item by a known field value (e.g. slug or name) before reading or updating it. Read-only and idempotent. Note: matching is an exact equality filter applied client-side over the fetched items, not a fuzzy or paginated server search.

get_collection_item.name: get_collection_item
get_collection_item.displayName: Get a Collection Item by ID
get_collection_item.description: Get collection item in a collection by ID

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Webflow CMS collection item by its collection ID and item ID. Use when the agent already knows the item ID and needs its full field data; if the ID is unknown, find it first with Find a Collection Item by Field. Read-only and idempotent.

send_order_fulfilled_email.description: Send an email to the customer that their order has been fulfilled

aiMetadata.description: Marks an existing Webflow Ecommerce order as fulfilled, identified by site ID and order ID, optionally sending the customer a fulfillment email. Use after shipping or completing an order. Setting fulfilled state is idempotent, but enabling the email may resend a notification, so prefer leaving it off when retrying.

Reverts an existing Webflow Ecommerce order back to an unfulfilled state, identified by site ID and order ID. Use to undo a fulfillment marking. Idempotent: re-running on an already-unfulfilled order leaves it unfulfilled.

Issues a refund for an existing Webflow Ecommerce order, identified by site ID and order ID. Use to reverse a customer payment. This moves money and is not idempotent — repeating it risks duplicate refund attempts, so call it once per order.
Retrieves a single Webflow Ecommerce order by its site ID and order ID. Use to look up order details before fulfilling, refunding, or unfulfilling it. Read-only and idempotent.

Publishes a Webflow CMS collection item live, identified by collection ID and item ID, so its current content goes to the live site. Use after creating or updating a draft item to make it public. Idempotent: re-publishing the same item again leaves it published.

Lists all Webflow sites accessible to the authenticated account, returning their IDs and metadata. Use to discover a site ID needed by other actions (collections, orders, form-submission trigger). Read-only and idempotent; takes no input.

list_collections.name: list_collections
list_collections.description: List all collections in a site

aiMetadata.description: Lists all CMS collections within a given Webflow site, identified by site ID, returning their IDs and metadata. Use to discover a collection ID before reading, creating, or updating collection items. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_submission.name: new_submission
new_submission.description: Triggers when Webflow Site receives a new submission

formName.description: Copy from the form settings, or from one of the responses

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a form on the selected Webflow site receives a new submission, delivering the submitted form data. Optionally scoped to a single form by name; if no form name is given, it fires for submissions from any form on the site.
